This page is the interactive version of the lesson notes (PDF). Each section
starts with a problem at a game studio. Then it explains the idea behind it.
It ends with a **Do it** task and one set of questions. The full
explanations, examples and exercises are in the notes.

## Key terms

{{< glossary app-store developer-account store-listing app-signing build-number age-rating privacy-policy app-review staged-rollout >}}

## 17.1 The road to the store

- **Account → build → listing → rating and privacy → review → release.**
- Each step can stop the launch; accounts and the first review take days.
- Byte Bay starts three weeks before the launch day.

![The road to the store.](images/road-to-store.png){width=90%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Do not open the accounts one day before the launch.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Plan the road"}
Write the six steps for your own small game, with one thing to prepare for
each step.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · The steps"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="the players|a website"}
What is the first step?
:   a developer account

Which step comes right before the release?
:   the review

Which package goes to Google Play?
:   .aab

Which package goes to the App Store?
:   .ipa
:::
:::

## 17.2 The store listing

- Name (at most **30** characters), short text (Google: **80**; Apple
  subtitle: **30**), long description.
- Icon: Google Play **512 × 512**; App Store **1024 × 1024**.
- Screenshots of the **real** game; category; contact.
- Limits of 2026: check the help pages.

![A store listing.](images/listing-parts.png){width=90%}

{{< sim file="sims/listing-builder.html" poster="sims/listing-builder.png" title="Store Listing Builder: is Pocket Quest ready?" height="780" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Screenshots of a "nicer" game are a misleading listing.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Make the listing ready"}
Fix every problem in **Store Listing Builder** for Google Play, then switch
to the App Store. Which line becomes a problem?
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · The listing"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="100 characters|256 × 256"}
How long may an app name be?
:   30 characters

Which icon size does Google Play want?
:   512 × 512

Which icon size does the App Store want?
:   1024 × 1024

How long may the Google Play short description be?
:   80 characters
:::
:::

## 17.3 Signing, versions, rating and privacy

- **Signing:** the studio's secret key; updates only with the same key.
- **Build number** grows with every upload (12 → 13); players see 1.0 →
  1.0.1.
- **Age rating:** from the studio's honest answers to a questionnaire.
- **Privacy:** a policy link + a data form (Data safety / privacy labels).

![Signing and versions.](images/signing-versions.png){width=90%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Wrong answers in the rating questionnaire can remove the game later.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Rate a game"}
For a game you know: violence? bad language? purchases? chat with
strangers? Which age group do you expect?
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Behind the listing"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="12 again|the players"}
Version 1.0 had build 12. Which build number for 1.0.1?
:   13

Why keep the signing key safe?
:   updates need the same key

Who answers the age-rating questionnaire?
:   the studio

What do both stores ask about privacy?
:   a policy link and a data form
:::
:::

## 17.4 Review, testing tracks and release

- **App review:** every game and update is checked.
- **Testing tracks:** internal, closed, open tests (iOS: TestFlight).
- **Staged rollout:** 5 % → 20 % → 50 % → 100 %; stop if the crash rate
  rises.

![Testing tracks and a staged rollout.](images/release-tracks.png){width=90%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
An update for everyone at once on a Friday night spreads a bug to all.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · A release plan"}
Write a release plan for version 1.2: testing track, how long, rollout
steps.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 4 · Release"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="delete the game|release to all"}
The crash rate rises at 5 %. What does Byte Bay do?
:   stop the rollout and fix the bug

Which iOS app gives test builds to testers?
:   TestFlight

What is checked by the store before release?
:   every game and every update

What comes after a closed test?
:   an open test or the release
:::
:::

## Game challenge: Launch Day {.challenge}

Work alone. Use every section of today.

Byte Bay publishes **Pocket Quest 1.0**: the account, a used version code, a
lost key, a misleading listing, the age rating, a rejection for privacy and
a safe release of 1.1.

{{< sim file="sims/launch-day.html" poster="sims/launch-day.png" title="Launch Day: from the build to the players" kind="game" height="560" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 5 · Launch day"}
Choose the right step.

::: {.match extra="change the name|a Mac"}
Upload fails: version code 12 was used.
:   upload with a higher version code

The listing shows another art style.
:   use screenshots of the real game

Rejected: no privacy policy.
:   add the policy link and the data form

Version 1.1 may have a hidden bug.
:   a staged rollout
:::
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 6 · Check the listing (harder)"}
Is it ready? Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="too big for Google|needs a new build number"}
Name "Pocket Quest" (12 characters).
:   ready for both stores

Icon 512 × 512 on the App Store.
:   too small for Apple

Subtitle of 45 characters on the App Store.
:   too long for Apple

No privacy policy, but the game collects e-mail addresses.
:   not ready for either store
:::
:::

## Summary {.summary}

- Publishing: account, build, listing, rating and privacy, review, release.
- The listing has limits: 30-character name, the right icon size, real
  screenshots.
- Builds are signed; the build number grows with every upload.
- Honest age rating; privacy policy and data form in both stores.
- Test in tracks, then release step by step.
